notes: The even of even the land of Canaan is added: the verse's one object marker stands on the children of Israel, which the ASV renders bare (rule 16).
li-gvuloteha is read as one preposition rendered according to, headed on according under rule 24.
The of before Canaan at t016 could equally be placed by rule 33 (appositional nominal with a supplied preposition) rather than rule 19; the unit and its head are identical either way.
